honesty: Retrospective diagnostic; baseline14 results already viewed. Not a new blind holdout.
primary_cohort: Exactly the14 frozen actual_tipster_vote snapshot IDs in PR558 performance-after.json. No prior policy, no market fallback, no later revision.

rules.definition: Use original saved full-game winner selection and price.
Choose largest normalized frozen market_probability within the same moneyline product (market,label,line), never another market. Ties abstain.
Choose argmax(0.90*normalized frozen market_probability +0.10*vote_share), within same moneyline product. Ties abstain. Vote share is a ranking heuristic, not calibrated win probability.
Keep original vote only when it equals the unique market top choice; otherwise abstain. Report coverage and baseline on identical retained subset; no claim of all-fixture predictive lift.

risk_ledger: No live bets, no wallet change; existing monthly -50000won paper ledger preserved. ROI is uncapped equal-stake diagnostic, not that account return.
grading: Direct official Betman DOM-normalized same event, kickoff, full-game market, label and n-way; reject contradictions. Use captured frozen option odds, never official closing odds. A picked option must match selection_id and offer_id computed from the frozen fixture and saved product.
timing: as_of,captured_at,market_observed_at and all vote receipts strictly before T30; no fixture facts obtained after that time are inputs.
uncertainty: Exact paired McNemar for equal eligible fixture comparisons; no fitted weights on these14, no promotion based on tiny same-period improvement.
secondary: If broadening, show same-period current-policy fallback rows separately and never call them tipster-evaluated matches.
